description: The Linhof Precision Camera Standard II and Technika II are the standard and advanced versions of a new model of the Linhof Precision Camera, a folding field camera made in various sizes from about 1937 to the 1940s.McKeown dates the Standard model to 1936, as a new version of the Präzisions-Camera,
